summary: This 8-K updates News Corp's buyback program. The company is authorized to repurchase up to $1 billion of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing provides copies of daily transaction disclosures made to the ASX under Australian rules. No specific terms such as price or per-share value are given; the disclosure is procedural. The board has previously authorized the program, and no advisor is named. The repurchase will be conducted from time to time, subject to market conditions and securities laws. For investors, watch actual buyback execution rates as a signal of management's view on intrinsic value.
